subject: Post-demo: Contract edit ownership & SLA for MSA/DPA
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Elaine Turner <elaine.turner@acmehealth.com>; Procurement Team <procurement@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>; Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 09 Nov 2026 14:02:00 -0800
Subject: Post-demo recap + who owns MSA/DPA edits (MAP milestone)

Hi Elaine / ACME team,

Thanks again for taking the demo this morning — appreciate the thoughtful questions on data residency and token retention. As discussed, I pulled together a short Mutual Action Plan (attached) and wanted to confirm next steps specifically for the legal milestone (MSA / DPA / SLA redlines).

Key asks from our side:
- Confirm who will own round-1 edits for MSA and DPA (ACME legal vs Redwood legal).
- Agree target turnaround times for each round so we can set realistic close date in MAP.
- Identify any dependencies (third-party integrations / KMS certification) that might affect legal review.

I attached the MAP draft (MAP-draft-v1.docx) and a suggested responsibility matrix. Our suggested default: Redwood handles initial MSA language updates for platform/security sections; ACME provides commercial and procurement redlines. We recommend 3 business days TAT per round for each side for the first two rounds, then 5 business days for any subsequent rounds. If either party needs more than 5 business days, we escalate to legal leads (Marissa / ACME GC) to avoid timeline slip.

Target close in MAP: 2026-11-23 (subject to the redline cadence below). Please confirm who will own the first pass and whether the 3 business day cadence works for ACME.

Cheers,
Karthik
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
---

From: Elaine Turner <elaine.turner@acmehealth.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@acmehealth.com>; ACME Health Legal <legal@acmehealth.com>; Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap + who owns MSA/DPA edits (MAP milestone)

Thanks Karthik — useful recap.

ACME prefers that Redwood produce the first consolidated MSA/DPA draft with your suggested security annex language and then we’ll annotate commercial terms. Two clarifications from legal:
1) Can Redwood confirm an initial redline turnaround of 48-72 hours for your first-pass edits? That will help our procurement schedule.
2) We have a standard SLA appendix template we’d like included; can you accept redlines to that template or should we merge?

I attached ACME's annotated redlines (ACME-redlines-annotated.pdf) for visibility — these are preliminary notes from our GC office. If Redwood can do the first consolidated pass by EOD Thursday (2026-11-12), we should be able to hit a 11/23 close assuming one round from us and one final reconciliation.

—Elaine
Director of IT Procurement
ACME Health

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>; Elaine Turner <elaine.turner@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 12:11:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap + who owns MSA/DPA edits (MAP milestone)

Hi all — looping in legal ownership and SLAs. Per internal alignment:
- Redwood Legal (Marissa) will produce the consolidated first-pass MSA/DPA edits by 2026-11-12 EOD as requested. That will include the security annex and suggested SLA language.
- Proposed review cadence: Redwood first-pass (0), ACME round-1 (3 business days), Redwood reconciliation (2 business days), final signoff round (2 business days). Total planned redline cycle: ~10 business days.
- Escalation path: if any single round exceeds 5 business days without agreed extension, Marissa will escalate to VP Legal (Ben Carter) and request an SLA exception decision.

I will attach the consolidated draft to the HubSpot deal and send a DocuSign envelope for signature-ready MSA once both parties confirm redline reconciliation.

Marissa
Senior Counsel | Redwood Inference
---

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>; Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>; Elaine Turner <elaine.turner@acmehealth.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 10:23:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap + who owns MSA/DPA edits (MAP milestone)

Quick confirmation from my side:
- I approve the proposed ownership split (Redwood: security/platform clauses; ACME: commercial/payment clauses).
- SLA for each review round: Redwood will aim for 48-72 hours for first-pass and 2 business days for reconciliation rounds.
- If ACME needs a change to the SLA appendix template, we’ll accept redlines but will flag any deviations that increase platform risk (e.g., <99.9% uptime exceptions).

Action items:
1) Marissa: Upload consolidated draft to HubSpot and attach DocuSign placeholder (due 2026-11-12 EOD).
2) Karthik: Update MAP milestone dates to reflect the 48-72 hr / 3 business day cadence and target close 2026-11-23.
3) Elaine: Confirm ACME will do round-1 within 3 business days after receipt.

Ben Carter
VP, Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
